edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the mint recipient during construction, fixing the initial supply holder.
enableTrading writes block.timestamp into lastLpBurnTime, making burn scheduling timestamp dependent.
_transfer compares block.timestamp against lastLpBurnTime plus lpBurnFrequency to trigger auto burn.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the router swap deadline.
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the router liquidity deadline.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens sets lastLpBurnTime from block.timestamp.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens uses block.timestamp for both cooldown check and last burn time.
_transfer uses tx.origin to enforce the per-block transfer delay restriction.
tx.origin is written into _holderLastTransferTimestamp as the delay key.
Constructor stores the fixed router address into uniswapV2Router.
Constructor creates and stores the Uniswap pair address.
Constructor calls excludeFromMaxTransaction to whitelist router and pair.
Constructor calls excludeFromFees to whitelist owner, contract and dead address.
Constructor calls _setAutomatedMarketMakerPair on the created pair.
enableTrading sets tradingActive to true with onlyOwner protection.
enableTrading sets swapEnabled to true.
enableTrading initializes lastLpBurnTime.
removeLimits irreversibly sets limitsInEffect to false.
disableTransferDelay irreversibly sets transferDelayEnabled to false.
updateSwapTokensAtAmount writes the swap threshold state variable.
updateMaxTxnAmount writes maxTransactionAmount.
updateMaxWalletAmount writes maxWallet.
excludeFromMaxTransaction writes the _isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount mapping.
updateSwapEnabled writes the swapEnabled flag.
updateBuyFees writes buyTotalFees and component fee variables.
updateSellFees writes sellTotalFees and component fee variables.
excludeFromFees writes the _isExcludedFromFees mapping.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair delegates the mapping write to the internal function.
_setAutomatedMarketMakerPair writes the automatedMarketMakerPairs mapping.
updateMarketingWallet rewrites marketingWallet.
updateDevWallet rewrites devWallet.
_transfer toggles the swapping guard around swapBack.
_transfer writes block.number into the transfer timestamp mapping.
_transfer reads buyTotalFees to compute the buy fee amount.
_transfer reads sellTotalFees to compute the sell fee amount.
_transfer accumulates tokensForMarketing from collected fees.
_transfer accumulates tokensForLiquidity from collected fees.
_transfer accumulates tokensForDev from collected fees.
_transfer calls swapBack when the contract balance exceeds the threshold.
_transfer may call autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens on sells to the pair.
swapTokensForEth reads the router address and its WETH for the swap path.
swapTokensForEth invokes the external router swap, which transfers tokens back into the contract.
addLiquidity invokes the external router addLiquidityETH call.
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth to convert tokens into ETH.
swapBack calls addLiquidity to add liquidity with a share of the ETH.
swapBack performs an unchecked low-level ETH call to devWallet.
swapBack performs an unchecked low-level ETH call sending remaining balance to marketingWallet.
swapBack reads and then zeroes tokensForMarketing.
swapBack reads and then zeroes tokensForLiquidity.
swapBack reads and then zeroes tokensForDev.
setAutoLPBurnSettings writes lpBurnFrequency.
setAutoLPBurnSettings writes percentForLPBurn.
setAutoLPBurnSettings writes lpBurnEnabled.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens reads balances of the uniswapV2Pair address.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens multiplies pair balance by percentForLPBurn.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls pair.sync() on the external pair contract.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens reads balances of the uniswapV2Pair address.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls pair.sync() on the external pair contract.
transferOwnership rewrites the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to the zero address.
owner() reads _owner and is used by the onlyOwner access checks.
Low-level call to devWallet transfers control to an external address before swapBack completes.
Low-level call to marketingWallet transfers control to an external address and forwards the full remaining balance.
Router swap executes an external transfer that re-enters the token _transfer logic.
Router addLiquidityETH pulls tokens via transferFrom, re-entering the token _transfer logic.
pair.sync() is an external call that can be used as a reentrancy pivot against transfer state.
ETH forwarded by the devWallet call is derived from the devWallet address target.
Remaining ETH forwarded by the marketing call is sent to marketingWallet.
from parameter drives all branch decisions and balance writes in _transfer.
to parameter drives AMM and exemption branch decisions in _transfer.
amount parameter is used in limit checks and fee arithmetic in _transfer.
Local fees value results from mul/div on amount and is deducted before the final transfer.
Local amountToBurn results from mul/div on pair balance and percentForLPBurn.
percent parameter feeds the burn amount computation and the 1000 bound check.
contractBalance caps the amount of tokens processed inside swapBack.
totalTokensToSwap divisor determines liquidity and ETH distribution ratios.
ethForDev is the value passed into the low-level devWallet call.
ethForMarketing is the marketing share involved in the final balance transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter has no meaning outside _transfer and only feeds that function's logic.
The to parameter is only consumed by _transfer's conditional branches.
The amount parameter is only used in _transfer's limit and fee arithmetic.
The local fee accumulator exists solely inside _transfer's execution.
amountToBurn is a temporary computed only within autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens.
The percent argument is only meaningful as input to manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens.
contractBalance is a temporary balance read used only inside swapBack.
totalTokensToSwap is a derived sum used only for swapBack distribution math.
ethForDev is the value handed to the devWallet low-level call and has no other use.
ethForMarketing is the marketing fee share associated with the final balance transfer call.
